name: Replit Agent
official_status_notes: Agent builds apps through chat on Replit (Agent v2+); built-in DB, auth, deployments, testing; agent tests its own work (verified Sep 2026).
pricing_summary: Free tier; paid plans include agent usage (Core/Pro).
best_for: Non-experts and founders who want chat-to-app with hosting included.
strengths: All-in-one (IDE + DB + auth + hosting), autonomous agent, browser test loop.
weaknesses: Not a traditional coding workflow; lock-in to Replit.

name: Lovable
official_status_notes: AI full-stack app builder (React/TypeScript) with chat + editor, DB/Auth, deployment, image-generation. Verify current pricing.
strengths: Great default stack (React/TS/CSS), deploy + auth + DB included.
weaknesses: Proprietary; UI-agent/builder rather than an editor agent.

name: Bolt.new
official_status_notes: AI web/app builder running the full stack in the browser (WebContainers); auto model routing; Bolt Cloud adds backend (verified Sep 2026).
pricing_summary: Free tier; Pro/Max with bigger token limits.
best_for: Rapid full-stack prototypes; modern front-end builds.
strengths: In-browser execution, Figma import, Bolt Cloud backends.
weaknesses: Proprietary; costs jump with heavy usage tokens.

name: v0
official_status_notes: Vercel's AI UI generation + full-stack app building with one-click Vercel deploy, GitHub sync, design/edit modes (verified Sep 2026).
pricing_summary: Free tier (limited credits); paid plans via Vercel.
best_for: Rapid UI/front-end generation inside the Vercel/Next.js ecosystem.
strengths: Excellent UI quality, React/Next+shadcn, design mode, deploy to Vercel.

name: Magic
official_status_notes: AI software engineer + IDE that works in your repo; no-code interface on top of real code. Verify pricing.
best_for: Product-minded users who want an autonomous engineer on a real repo.

name: Onlook
official_status_notes: Open-source (Apache-2.0) AI-first visual editor for React (Next.js + Tailwind): edit designs directly on your real codebase; hosted product in early access; MCP support and OpenRouter-based model access in the open-source stack (verified Sep 2026).
pricing_summary: Open source, free to self-host; hosted product pricing not yet verified.
best_for: Design-minded developers who want to edit a real React codebase visually with AI.
strengths: Open source; code-native (reads/writes real Next.js/Tailwind); MCP; checkpoints.
weaknesses: Focused on Next.js + Tailwind today; hosted product still in early access.
hardware_requirements: Desktop app + local preview container; modest projects fit 8 GB.

name: bolt.diy
official_status_notes: Open-source (MIT) community evolution of bolt.new: prompt, run, edit, and deploy full-stack web apps in the browser (WebContainers) using your choice of LLM/provider (many providers plus Ollama); Electron desktop builds; WebContainer API needs a commercial license in production (verified Sep 2026).
license: MIT (code); WebContainer API license applies in production
pricing_summary: Free, open source; you bring the model keys (or run local models).
best_for: Self-hosting a bolt.new-style app builder with your own model keys, including local models.
strengths: Open source; any-LLM BYOK including Ollama; runs in the browser.
weaknesses: Community-maintained; model quality varies; commercial WebContainer licensing.
